# ORBYN TECH Apps

> Apps by ORBYN TECH, a brand of LCH NETWORK MARKETING. Contact: admin@lchnetmarketing.com.

## Apps and policies

- [App collection](https://apps.lchnetmarketing.com/): The ORBYN TECH app list.
- [STCW Tracker](https://apps.lchnetmarketing.com/stcw-tracker/): Track STCW certificates, expiry dates and sea service. Offline and private.
- [STCW Tracker privacy policy](https://apps.lchnetmarketing.com/stcw-tracker/privacy/): Local data, reminders, app lock, exports, purchases and deletion. Effective 20 October 2026.
- [STCW Tracker terms of use](https://apps.lchnetmarketing.com/stcw-tracker/terms/): App use and user responsibilities. Effective 20 October 2026.
- [Site Measure Check: Room QA privacy policy](https://apps.lchnetmarketing.com/site-measure-check/privacy/): Site Measure Check records local room observations, evaluates declared measurement relationships, and prepares a revision-bound handoff PDF when readiness conditions pass. Privacy policy effective 19 October 2026.

- [Watt to Amp Calculator](https://apps.lchnetmarketing.com/watt-to-amp/): DC, single-phase and three-phase current calculations, power factor and circuit load checks. Free with ads; optional one-time Pro. Reference only.
- [Watt to Amp Calculator privacy policy](https://apps.lchnetmarketing.com/watt-to-amp/privacy/): Local calculations and projects, Google Mobile Ads and consent, purchases and PDF reports. Effective 21 October 2026.

- Terms of Use: https://apps.lchnetmarketing.com/watt-to-amp/terms/
- Terms of Use: https://apps.lchnetmarketing.com/site-measure-check/terms/
- Terms of Use: https://apps.lchnetmarketing.com/steel-weight/terms/
